name: Conventions: triage seeded candidates and turn an accepted one into a skill
description: Reaches the Conventions page from the SKILLS LAB sidebar, confirms the seeded candidates render with their confidence and evidence path, accepts one, opens the Create-skill modal and creates repo-conventions, then confirms the skill is in the Skills library. Exercises GET /repos/:id/conventions, PATCH /conventions/:id, GET and POST /repos/:id/conventions/skill. The seed stands in for a finished scan — Run Scan is never pressed, so no model call.
